trap.label: verbo + infinitivo
trap.wrong: I expect getting a reply soon.
trap.right: I expect to get a reply soon.
trap.why: Em português “espero receber” é infinitivo, mas o brasileiro troca por -ing. Expect, hope, promise pedem to + base.

fix.right: He expects to arrive at six.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o passado: “I expect to get a reply.”
rewrite.answer: I expected to get a reply.

rewrite.prompt: Use get: “Someone fixed my phone.” (I got…)
